events.command:
/usr/bin/bash -lc "set -euo pipefail
# Expected run metadata: bioproject, run, layout, spots
awk 'BEGIN{FS=OFS=\"\\t\"} FNR==1{delete h; for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) h["'$i]=i; next} {print $h["bioproject"],$h["run_accession"],$h["library_layout"],$h["run_total_spots"]}'"' final_answer/metadata/PRJNA1354216.tsv final_answer/metadata/PRJNA1339024.tsv | sort -k2,2 > run_trace/expected_runs.tsv
# Manifest normalized comparable rows.
awk 'BEGIN{FS=OFS=\"\\t\"} NR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) h["'$i]=i; next} {print $h["bioproject"],$h["run_accession"],$h["library_layout"],$h["forward_path"],$h["reverse_path"]}'"' final_answer/run_manifest.tsv | sort -k2,2 > run_trace/manifest_runs.tsv
# Check metadata bioproject values match filenames.
for acc in PRJNA1354216 PRJNA1339024; do
  awk -v acc=\""'$acc" '"'BEGIN{FS=\"\\t\"} NR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) h["'$i]=i; next} $h["bioproject"]!=acc{bad++} END{if(bad){exit 1}}'"' \"final_answer/metadata/"'$acc.tsv"
done
# Check manifest paths and layout fields.
awk '"'BEGIN{FS=\"\\t\"} NR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) h["'$i]=i; next} {
  fp="final_answer/" $h["forward_path"]; rp=$h["reverse_path"]=="" ? "" : "final_answer/" $h["reverse_path"];
  if($h["library_layout"]=="SINGLE" && $h["reverse_path"]!="") {print "single reverse not empty",$h["run_accession"] > "/dev/stderr"; exit 1}
  if($h["library_layout"]=="PAIRED" && $h["reverse_path"]=="") {print "paired reverse empty",$h["run_accession"] > "/dev/stderr"; exit 1}
  if(system("test -s '"\\\"\" fp \"\\\"\")"'!=0) {print "missing forward",fp > "/dev/stderr"; exit 1}
  if(rp!="" && system("test -s '"\\\"\" rp \"\\\"\")"'!=0) {print "missing reverse",rp > "/dev/stderr"; exit 1}
}'"' final_answer/run_manifest.tsv
# Check run set equality.
cut -f1-3 run_trace/expected_runs.tsv > run_trace/expected_runset.tsv
cut -f1-3 run_trace/manifest_runs.tsv > run_trace/manifest_runset.tsv
cmp -s run_trace/expected_runset.tsv run_trace/manifest_runset.tsv
# Count FASTQ records for each file and compare to spots.
: > run_trace/fastq_record_counts.tsv
while IFS="'$'"'\\t' read -r bp run layout spots; do
  if [ \""'$layout" = "SINGLE" ]; then
    lines=$(zcat "final_answer/reads/${run}.fastq.gz" | wc -l)
    rec=$((lines / 4))
    printf '"'%s\\t%s\\tSINGLE\\t%s\\t%s\\n' \""'$run" "forward" "$rec" "$spots" >> run_trace/fastq_record_counts.tsv
    [ "$rec" -eq "$spots" ]
  else
    lines1=$(zcat "final_answer/reads/${run}_1.fastq.gz" | wc -l)
    lines2=$(zcat "final_answer/reads/${run}_2.fastq.gz" | wc -l)
    rec1=$((lines1 / 4)); rec2=$((lines2 / 4))
    printf '"'%s\\t%s\\tPAIRED\\t%s\\t%s\\n' \""'$run" "forward" "$rec1" "$spots" >> run_trace/fastq_record_counts.tsv
    printf '"'%s\\t%s\\tPAIRED\\t%s\\t%s\\n' \""'$run" "reverse" "$rec2" "$spots" >> run_trace/fastq_record_counts.tsv
    [ "$rec1" -eq "$spots" ] && [ "$rec2" -eq "$spots" ]
  fi
done < run_trace/expected_runs.tsv
printf '"'validation_ok\\n'
sed -n '1,40p' run_trace/fastq_record_counts.tsv"
